import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/test_0.csv"

# Load source tables
# Note: index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column as per Hint 24
source0_df = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation plan:
# - Target schema: ['V_GENE']
# - Source0 schema: ['J_CALL']
# - The target column V_GENE corresponds to the J_CALL column in source0, but without the allele suffix (e.g., '*02').
# - So we need to extract the part before '*' from J_CALL to get V_GENE.
# - There is only one source table, so no union or join needed.
# - Output the transformed data to the target path.

# Extract V_GENE from J_CALL by splitting on '*'
source0_df['V_GENE'] = source0_df['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]

# Select only the target column
target_df = source0_df[['V_GENE']]

# Write the result to the specified path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource.csv")
